name: Lozhnoye solntse
source:
The False Sun is a first-person visual novel about a summer spent in a small village, where warm days, quiet fields, and familiar faces slowly give way to something far more unsettling.

You return to your grandfather’s farm with no clear memory of the time you once spent there. The village remembers you. And so does Silas — your childhood friend, whom you can’t remember, even though he seems to know you far too well.

Help around the farm, spend time with Silas, uncover fragments of the past, and follow your choices toward one of 20 possible endings.

[From [url=https://oniray.itch.io/the-false-sun]Itch.io[/url]]
